info.name: WoodCraft ERP API
info.description:
WoodCraft ERP backend API.

How to use:
1. Collection Variables: set email and password (and baseUrl if your port is not 5000).
2. Auth > Login (saves accessToken).
3. Organization > My Organizations or Create Organization (saves organizationId).
4. Use any other request. Bearer token and x-organization-id header are added automatically.

Modules: Auth, Organization, Membership, Billing, Warehouse, Category, Supplier, Item, Stock, Stock Movement, Purchase Order, Goods Receipt, Batch, Quality Inspection, Transfer, Production (BOM, Production Order, Material Issue, Work Order), Adjustment, Scraps.
